payload.summary: L70 dispatcher reconcile uncovered two issues. (1) NOTE-CORRECTION: pipeline-state gate timestamp 16:30Z → 23:30Z (cron is '30 23 * * *' UTC per cronConfig.ts:128, container TZ=UTC). 16:30Z window did NOT fire (logs --since 1h grep dailyDashboard = empty). (2) FIX-1974: missing host bind-mount for docs/data/daily-dashboard.json — dailyDashboardJob.ts:509 writes to /app/docs/data/daily-dashboard.json inside container but docker-compose mcp-server volume list only mounts 3 individual :ro files in /app/docs/data/ (project-stats.json, stock-classification.json, alert-verdicts.json). Output is invisible to host AND will be lost on container restart. AC-5.2 at 23:30Z cannot be host-verified without this fix.

items.evidence: apps/mcp-server/src/scheduler/cronConfig.ts:128 = '30 23 * * *'; docker exec date confirms UTC; logs --since 1h | grep dailyDashboard = empty (no 16:30Z fire); daily-dashboard.json absent on host AND in container.

items.title: Add host bind-mount for docs/data/daily-dashboard.json
items.desc: dailyDashboardJob.ts writes to /app/docs/data/daily-dashboard.json (path.join(getProjectRoot(), 'docs/data/daily-dashboard.json')) inside the mcp-server container. docker-compose.yml mcp-server volumes (lines 11-19) only declare 3 single-file :ro mounts in /app/docs/data/ — no bind for daily-dashboard.json. Result: write succeeds in container ephemeral layer, host sees nothing, restart loses the file, AC-5.2 cannot be host-verified at 22T23:30Z.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: docker-compose.yml mcp-server volume list grants the container write access to ./docs/data/daily-dashboard.json on host (NOT :ro). Implementer chooses: (a) touch ./docs/data/daily-dashboard.json with empty {} first, then add single-file bind-mount, OR (b) bind the whole ./docs/data:/app/docs/data directory rw and drop the 3 :ro single-file mounts (verify nothing else writes those 3 files from a non-mcp-server source).

AC-2: After `docker compose up -d` and a manual job trigger (or wait for 23:30Z fire), `ls -la docs/data/daily-dashboard.json` on host shows file with current mtime AND `jq . docs/data/daily-dashboard.json` exits 0 with non-empty top-level keys.
AC-3: File survives `docker compose restart mcp-server` (i.e. content unchanged post-restart, not zeroed).

AC-4: Existing 3 :ro mounts (project-stats.json, stock-classification.json, alert-verdicts.json) continue to be honored as read-only inside the container (writes from container fail). Test by exec'ing into container and attempting `echo x > /app/docs/data/project-stats.json` — must EACCES.
AC-5: Baseline tests still pass (9277/9277). No new test required (Docker compose change, infra-only).

AC-6: If option (b) is chosen and docker-compose mounts the whole ./docs/data directory, the bind must NOT shadow daily-dashboard.json — verify by triggering the job once and confirming host sees the write.
items.verification_hook: Tie to OBSERVE-1960-DAILYDASH-CRON gate at 22T23:30Z — AC-5.2 verification reads host file. Without this fix, AC-5.2 = FAIL by construction.
items.do_not_dispatch_if: WIP > 0 on dev-mcp-server zone (current WIP=0/2, safe).
items.rationale_for_now_vs_later: 23:30Z fire is ~6h08min out. If we wait until 23:30Z to discover host-invisible output, we lose the verification window and must re-fire next day. XS fix, single file edit, zero blast radius outside mcp-server zone.
